sourceEvidence.observed: The Tully listing gives the placement instructions, term dates, class days and hours, and lists the instructor as TBD.
The college calls the assessment Guided Self-Placement and uses it to help students choose an ESL class.

events.title: ESL Classes with Evergreen Valley College (EVC) 502: Listening & Speaking

cases.refreshed: ESL Listening & Speaking 1 is a noncredit course for high-beginning English learners. Students will learn to pronounce basic words accurately, communicate effectively, understand and use basic grammar structures, and build their foundational vocabulary. To enroll, complete and pass the Self-Guided Computer Assessment. This is not a test—it's simply an assessment to help us place you in the most appropriate ESL class based on your current English level. To ensure accurate results, the GSP should be completed independently and in a quiet setting, without assistance from others. Submit the registration form. To schedule your assessment appointment, send an email to marcela.guevara@sjlibrary.org. ESL 502 Course Information: Starts: August 25, 2026; Ends: December 10, 2026; Class Days: Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday; Time: 5:15 PM – 6:45 PM; Instructor: TBD. We will assist you with the application and registration processes in person at the Educational Park Branch Library. Space is limited.
